key: It's so sad, seeing what everyone in the city has done to the lake.
en: It's so sad, seeing what everyone in the city has done to the lake.
ja: みんなが街でこの湖に何をしたか見ると、本当に悲しくなる。

key: I heard that a long time ago, there used to be all sorts of cute Pokémon in it.
en: I heard that a long time ago, there used to be all sorts of cute Pokémon in it.
ja: 昔は、いろんなかわいいポケモンがこの湖に住んでたって聞いたよ。

key: Have you ever seen a Luvdisc?
en: Have you ever seen a Luvdisc?
ja: ラブカスを見たことある?

key: They used to swim all around Azurine, but you never see them anymore.
en: They used to swim all around Azurine, but you never see them anymore.
ja: 昔はアズリンのあちこちを泳いでたのに、今じゃ全然見かけない。

key: Hey, if you ever find a Luvdisc, would you trade it to me?
en: Hey, if you ever find a Luvdisc, would you trade it to me?
ja: ねえ、もしラブカスを見つけたら、交換してくれない?

key: It would mean a lot to me to have some keepsake of how it used to be.
en: It would mean a lot to me to have some keepsake of how it used to be.
ja: 昔のこの場所の形見みたいなものが、あったらすごくうれしいんだ。

key: I could give you this Darumaka in return.
en: I could give you this Darumaka in return.
ja: お礼に、このダルマッカをあげられるよ。

key: Oh? You don't seem to have one.
en: Oh? You don't seem to have one.
ja: あら? 持ってなさそうだね。

key: That's it! Okay, let's trade!
en: That's it! Okay, let's trade!
ja: それだ! よし、交換しよう!

key: \PN traded Luvdisc for Darumaka!
en: \PN traded Luvdisc for Darumaka!
ja: \PNはラブカスをダルマッカと交換した!

key: Thank you, Trainer.
en: Thank you, Trainer.
ja: ありがとう、トレーナーさん。

key: I feel like this is an important step, at least for me to become comfortable with the way of things.
en: I feel like this is an important step, at least for me to become comfortable with the way of things.
ja: これは、少なくとも僕にとっては、物事を受け入れるための大事な一歩な気がするよ。

key: That's all right.
en: That's all right.
ja: それでいいんだ。

key: Perhaps I'll find one myself someday.
en: Perhaps I'll find one myself someday.
ja: いつか、自分でも見つけられるかもしれないし。

key: It's so cute!
en: It's so cute!
ja: すっごくかわいい!

key: Hyaaah!
en: Hyaaah!
ja: やあああっ!

key: Hah-- hah... Too much!
en: Hah-- hah... Too much!
ja: はぁ――はぁ……もう限界!

key: I must keep training!
en: I must keep training!
ja: もっと鍛えないと!

key: Apophyll Academy--\nTrain your mind with your body!
en: Apophyll Academy--\nTrain your mind with your body!
ja: アポフィルアカデミー――\n心と体を共に鍛えよ!

key: Man, nothing like a good spar! Ossu!
en: Man, nothing like a good spar! Ossu!
ja: やっぱり、いい組手には敵わないな! おっす!

key: You're lucky I was tired!
en: You're lucky I was tired!
ja: 俺が疲れてたから助かったな!

key: Here at Apophyll Academy, we train our bodies as hard as our minds, and vice-versa!
en: Here at Apophyll Academy, we train our bodies as hard as our minds, and vice-versa!
ja: ここアポフィルアカデミーでは、心を鍛えるのと同じくらい、体も鍛えます。もちろん、その逆もね!

key: Kiki is a great sensei! She really helps everyone all the time, and never loses her cool!
en: Kiki is a great sensei! She really helps everyone all the time, and never loses her cool!
ja: キキ先生は素晴らしいセンセイだよ! いつだってみんなを助けてくれるし、絶対に取り乱さないんだ!

key: That doesn't mean I'm the best student!
en: That doesn't mean I'm the best student!
ja: だからって、私が一番の生徒ってわけじゃないけどね!

key: Erp, someday I'll be as great as her!
en: Erp, someday I'll be as great as her!
ja: うっ、いつか先生みたいにすごくなってやる!

key: Round one, FAITO!
en: Round one, FAITO!
ja: ラウンド1、ファイト!

key: Victory!
en: Victory!
ja: 勝利!

key: I must remember: To learn from defeat is a greater victory than any outcome.
en: I must remember: To learn from defeat is a greater victory than any outcome.
ja: 忘れちゃいけない。敗北から学ぶことは、どんな結果よりも大きな勝利だってこと。

key: Welcome to Apophyll Academy!
en: Welcome to Apophyll Academy!
ja: アポフィルアカデミーへようこそ!

key: We are happy to accept new students and visitors alike!
en: We are happy to accept new students and visitors alike!
ja: 新しい生徒さんも、見学の方も、大歓迎です!

key: Huh?
en: Huh?
ja: え?

key: Victoria and some guy in purple and fishnets just bolted out of here in a flash...
en: Victoria and some guy in purple and fishnets just bolted out of here in a flash...
ja: ヴィクトリアと、紫の網タイツの男の人が、たった今すごい勢いで飛び出していったよ……

key: Is something going on?
en: Is something going on?
ja: 何かあったのかな?

key: Um, welcome to Apophyll Academy, I guess...
en: Um, welcome to Apophyll Academy, I guess...
ja: えっと、アポフィルアカデミーへ、ようこそ、なのかな……

key: We are technically still in operation...
en: We are technically still in operation...
ja: 一応、まだ営業中だよ……

key: ...Kinda.
en: ...Kinda.
ja: ……たぶん。

key: I think?
en: I think?
ja: だと思う?

key: Ugh, I can't focus at all!
en: Ugh, I can't focus at all!
ja: うう、全然集中できない!

key: Meditating is so difficult!
en: Meditating is so difficult!
ja: めい想って、すごく難しい!

key: Meditating is so difficult...
en: Meditating is so difficult...
ja: めい想って、すごく難しい……

key: Especially after everything that's happened!
en: Especially after everything that's happened!
ja: 特に、いろいろあった後だと!

key: VICTORIA: I guess I'm supposed to show you, as our newest student, all the ropes?
en: VICTORIA: I guess I'm supposed to show you, as our newest student, all the ropes?
ja: ヴィクトリア: 新入生のあなたに、いろいろ教えてあげる役目みたいですね?

key: Haha~
en: Haha~
ja: はは~

key: I think it's great that you were interested in joining, but let's set that all aside until the immediate issues are resolved.
en: I think it's great that you were interested in joining, but let's set that all aside until the immediate issues are resolved.
ja: 入学に興味を持ってくれてうれしいですが、目の前の問題が片づくまでは、それは後回しにしましょう。

key: VICTORIA: I just told Lettie what's going on, so...
en: VICTORIA: I just told Lettie what's going on, so...
ja: ヴィクトリア: レティにも状況を伝えたところなので……

key: I expect that by now every person from here to Unova knows what's going on.
en: I expect that by now every person from here to Unova knows what's going on.
ja: 今頃は、ここからウノーバまで、みんなが状況を知っているでしょうね。

key: I'm a little concerned about Kiki...
en: I'm a little concerned about Kiki...
ja: キキ先生のことが、少し心配です……

key: It's not good for her to push too hard, even with something like this.
en: It's not good for her to push too hard, even with something like this.
ja: こういうことでも、無理をしすぎるのは先生のためになりません。

key: Lately, she's been...
en: Lately, she's been...
ja: 最近、先生は……

key: Actually, that's not important right now.
en: Actually, that's not important right now.
ja: いえ、今それは重要じゃありませんね。

key: Did you want to go ahead and fight me?
en: Did you want to go ahead and fight me?
ja: 私と戦ってみますか?

key: VICTORIA: Sounds great, but I hope you know my pride as the foremost apprentice of this Academy won't let me hold back!
en: VICTORIA: Sounds great, but I hope you know my pride as the foremost apprentice of this Academy won't let me hold back!
ja: ヴィクトリア: いいでしょう、でもこのアカデミー筆頭門下生としての誇りにかけて、手加減はしませんよ!

key: Give me everything you've got!
en: Give me everything you've got!
ja: 全力でかかってきてください!

key: ...Nice work!
en: ...Nice work!
ja: ……お見事です!

key: VICTORIA: That was a strong showing!
en: VICTORIA: That was a strong showing!
ja: ヴィクトリア: 見事な戦いぶりでした!

key: No regrets.
en: No regrets.
ja: 悔いはありません。

key: I'll let Kiki know that you're clear to go on.
en: I'll let Kiki know that you're clear to go on.
ja: あなたが先へ進んでいいと、キキ先生に伝えておきます。

key: VICTORIA: Ah, you'd rather try your luck with Cal?
en: VICTORIA: Ah, you'd rather try your luck with Cal?
ja: ヴィクトリア: ああ、キャルの方で運試しをしたいんですね?

key: Pyrous Mountain's just a small walk to the west.
en: Pyrous Mountain's just a small walk to the west.
ja: パイロス山は、西に少し歩いたところです。

key: Sometimes the lava gets in the way, but if that happens, just go to the floor below and give the connecting pieces a good slug.
en: Sometimes the lava gets in the way, but if that happens, just go to the floor below and give the connecting pieces a good slug.
ja: 溶岩が邪魔をすることもありますが、そのときは下の階に行って、つながっている部分をひと押ししてください。

key: I know how he was before, but he's really mellowed out quickly!
en: I know how he was before, but he's really mellowed out quickly!
ja: 彼が前はどんな感じだったか知っていますが、本当に早く丸くなりましたよ!

key: Actually, I feel like I've really been able to personally help him with that.
en: Actually, I feel like I've really been able to personally help him with that.
ja: 実は、私自身がそれを個人的に手伝えた気がしていて。

key: It's been... nice?
en: It's been... nice?
ja: なんというか……良い経験でした?

key: Anyway, you've got this!
en: Anyway, you've got this!
ja: とにかく、あなたなら大丈夫です!

key: I will not lose focus, even in darkness.
en: I will not lose focus, even in darkness.
ja: 闇の中でも、集中を切らさない。

key: Hm, what class should I take this week?
en: Hm, what class should I take this week?
ja: うーん、今週はどの講義を取ろうかな?

key: "Becoming One With Your Pokémon" or "Understanding the Static and Dynamic in Battle"?
en: "Becoming One With Your Pokémon" or "Understanding the Static and Dynamic in Battle"?
ja: 「ポケモンと一体になる」か、「戦闘における静と動の理解」か?

key: We all have to be strong... For Kiki, right?
en: We all have to be strong... For Kiki, right?
ja: みんな強くならなきゃ……キキ先生のためにも、ね?

key: Every day, I am becoming a better and stronger version of myself.
en: Every day, I am becoming a better and stronger version of myself.
ja: 毎日、僕はより良く、より強い自分になっている。

key: With each step I take, I draw closer to my true purpose in this world.
en: With each step I take, I draw closer to my true purpose in this world.
ja: 一歩踏み出すごとに、この世界での本当の目的に近づいていく。

key: I see you walk an enlightened path as well. You must have learned much.
en: I see you walk an enlightened path as well. You must have learned much.
ja: あなたも悟りの道を歩んでいるようですね。きっと多くを学んだのでしょう。

key: Please take this one.
en: Please take this one.
ja: こちらをどうぞ。

key: Each of you, work to keep each other on a path of diligence, prosperity, and peace.
en: Each of you, work to keep each other on a path of diligence, prosperity, and peace.
ja: あなたたち、互いに励まし合って、努力と繁栄と平和の道を歩んでください。

key: You, too, must do the same.
en: You, too, must do the same.
ja: あなたも、同じようにしなければなりません。

key: Study, learn, grow.
en: Study, learn, grow.
ja: 学び、知り、成長しなさい。

key: When you reach zen, come again, and you will surely be rewarded.
en: When you reach zen, come again, and you will surely be rewarded.
ja: 禅の境地に達したら、また訪れなさい。きっと報われるでしょう。

key: Individual strength is relative only to one's own past.
en: Individual strength is relative only to one's own past.
ja: 個々の強さとは、自分自身の過去とだけ比べるべきもの。

key: If you strengthen your mind, your body will be strong, too!
en: If you strengthen your mind, your body will be strong, too!
ja: 心を鍛えれば、体もきっと強くなる!

key: You are strong in both. I have much to learn still.
en: You are strong in both. I have much to learn still.
ja: あなたは心も体も強いですね。私はまだまだ学ぶことが多い。

key: I owe my strength to Kiki. I have learned much from her, and I will continue to do so no matter what!
en: I owe my strength to Kiki. I have learned much from her, and I will continue to do so no matter what!
ja: 私の強さは、キキ先生のおかげです。先生から多くを学びましたし、これからも何があろうと学び続けます!

key: I can see the city from here!
en: I can see the city from here!
ja: ここから街が見える!

key: God, it's ugly.
en: God, it's ugly.
ja: うわ、汚いなあ。

key: Impressive, but ugly.
en: Impressive, but ugly.
ja: すごいけど、汚い。

key: Kiki has a match? Who's applying for graduation?
en: Kiki has a match? Who's applying for graduation?
ja: キキ先生が試合を? 誰が卒業試験を受けるの?

key: Kiki is quite an opponent. I feel sorry for whoever has to face her.
en: Kiki is quite an opponent. I feel sorry for whoever has to face her.
ja: キキ先生はなかなかの相手だよ。戦う羽目になった人には同情するね。

key: Go Kiki!
en: Go Kiki!
ja: 頑張れキキ先生!

key: Excellent! I'll use this time to study her technique!
en: Excellent! I'll use this time to study her technique!
ja: よし! この機会に先生の技術を研究しよう!

key: A graduation match? You can bet I'll be watching!
en: A graduation match? You can bet I'll be watching!
ja: 卒業試合? そりゃもちろん見るに決まってる!

key: Go Kiki, you're the best!
en: Go Kiki, you're the best!
ja: 頑張れキキ先生、最高だよ!

key: Put the challenger to the test!
en: Put the challenger to the test!
ja: 挑戦者に試練を!

key: Another perk of living here: Free entertainment.
en: Another perk of living here: Free entertainment.
ja: ここに住んでるもう一つの特典、タダの娯楽だ。

key: Live battles totally beat TV!
en: Live battles totally beat TV!
ja: 生の戦いは、テレビより絶対おもしろい!

key: VICTORIA: Battling is too much of a strain for her.
en: VICTORIA: Battling is too much of a strain for her.
ja: ヴィクトリア: 戦うのは、先生には負担が大きすぎます。

key: But she's decided, against all reason, to do this.
en: But she's decided, against all reason, to do this.
ja: でも先生は、理屈に反してでも、これをやると決めたんです。

key: So if you're going to beat her, make sure you do it on your first try.
en: So if you're going to beat her, make sure you do it on your first try.
ja: だから、勝つつもりなら、一度目で必ず決めてください。

key: I'm rooting for you.
en: I'm rooting for you.
ja: 応援しています。

key: KIKI: If you're ready, please take your place.
en: KIKI: If you're ready, please take your place.
ja: キキ: 準備ができたら、所定の位置についてください。

key: KIKI: \PN, let us see how well your discipline holds you.
en: KIKI: \PN, let us see how well your discipline holds you.
ja: キキ: \PN、あなたの鍛錬がどれほどのものか、見せてもらいましょう。

key: VICTORIA: ...The challenger, \PN, will now face the Sensei in a six-on-six Single Battle for the right to graduate.
en: VICTORIA: ...The challenger, \PN, will now face the Sensei in a six-on-six Single Battle for the right to graduate.
ja: ヴィクトリア: ……挑戦者\PNが、卒業をかけてセンセイと6対6のシングルバトルを行います。

key: KIKI: Welcome, once more.
en: KIKI: Welcome, once more.
ja: キキ: 再びようこそ。

key: I return as well, striking in perfect immobility, with all the fury that my soul may harbor.
en: I return as well, striking in perfect immobility, with all the fury that my soul may harbor.
ja: わたしもまた、完全なる不動をもって、魂に宿すすべての怒りとともに、打ち込みましょう。

key: VICTORIA: ...The challenger, \PN, will now rematch the Sensei in a six-on-six Single Battle for the right to graduate.
en: VICTORIA: ...The challenger, \PN, will now rematch the Sensei in a six-on-six Single Battle for the right to graduate.
ja: ヴィクトリア: ……挑戦者\PNが、卒業をかけて再びセンセイと6対6のシングルバトルを行います。

key: Either competitor can make substitutions.
en: Either competitor can make substitutions.
ja: どちらの選手も、交代は自由です。

key: The battle will end when all six of either Trainer's Pokémon are unable to battle.
en: The battle will end when all six of either Trainer's Pokémon are unable to battle.
ja: どちらかのトレーナーのポケモン6体すべてが、戦闘不能になった時点で終了します。

key: ...Begin.
en: ...Begin.
ja: ……始め。

key: ...And all was silent.
en: ...And all was silent.
ja: ……そして、すべては静寂に包まれた。

key: KIKI: Amidst true focus, your energy shines through.
en: KIKI: Amidst true focus, your energy shines through.
ja: キキ: 真の集中の中で、あなたの気迫が輝いています。

key: Your own hard work is unmistakeable.
en: Your own hard work is unmistakeable.
ja: あなた自身の努力は、紛れもないものです。

key: As the founding instructor of this establishment, I am pleased... to...
en: As the founding instructor of this establishment, I am pleased... to...
ja: この学び舎の創設師範として、わたしは……とても……

key: To...
en: To...

key: KIKI: ...Excuse me, I--
en: KIKI: ...Excuse me, I--
ja: キキ: ……失礼、わたしは――

key: VICTORIA: Kiki!
en: VICTORIA: Kiki!
ja: ヴィクトリア: キキ先生!

key: Meet the Fish of Destiny!
en: Meet the Fish of Destiny!
ja: 運命の魚をご覧あれ!

key: Fishy!!!
en: Fishy!!!
ja: 魚さーん!!!

key: Why did you do this to me?!
en: Why did you do this to me?!
ja: なんで俺にこんなことするんだよ!?

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
